title: Checking the News: How Sure Is the Report?
grammar: How certain is a news report
goal: I can say how sure a news report is with *kétséget kizáróan*, *igazolhatóan*, *feltehetőleg* and *nem zárható ki, hogy*.
I can name the steps of checking a news item (*tényellenőrzés*, *forráskritika*, *dezinformáció*).
I can write one short sentence about how far a report can be trusted.

sections.title: Unit 26: The Press, Truth and Responsibility
body: This unit is about the press and the truth: how sure a news report is, how texts mislead, how a false claim is refuted, what the press must do, and how to judge a journalist's conduct.
The unit ends with a text about Márai Sándor and his diary 'Napló' (1943–1948).
